artworks.title: Marquis de la Vrilliere
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a person in a formal pose within an intricately detailed oval frame. The individual is seated upright, facing forward, with their head turned slightly to their right. They have a fair complexion with delicate features and curly hair styled in a voluminous manner. The person is wearing an elaborate garment, possibly armor or ceremonial attire, with an embroidered sash and a lace cravat around their neck. The circular frame is surrounded by decorative elements like drapery and tassels, giving an impression of opulence. The background is textured like a detailed etching, and the frame includes a coat of arms at the bottom.

artworks.title: Isaac-Jacques de Verthamon
artworks.artist: Pierre-Imbert Drevet after François de Troy
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man dressed in clerical attire, with a round face, curly hair, and a calm expression. He is seated, facing slightly to the right, with a large collar, robe, and a cross around his neck. The image is surrounded by an ornate oval frame with inscriptions, a decorative crest, and an architectural base.

artworks.title: Nicolas de Blampignon
artworks.description: The illustration shows a man with a long face and curly hair, wearing a fur-lined robe. He is positioned in a slight turn to his left within an oval frame with inscriptions. A decorative crest is placed below the portrait, set against a finely detailed engraved background.

artworks.title: James III, Prince of Wales
artworks.artist: Gerard Edelinck after François de Troy
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a bust-length portrait inside an oval frame. The person is positioned in a three-quarters view turned slightly to their right. They have prominent facial features, long curly hair, and are wearing 17th or 18th-century clothing with a high lace collar and a draped sash. The frame is elaborate with two circular medallions on each side. The background is plain textured, with an additional small oval frame at the bottom center showing the sea with rays of light. The image is monochromatic, resembling an engraved print.

artworks.title: Jacques III, Roy d'Angleterre (James III, Prince of Wales)
artworks.artist: Gerard Edelinck after François de Troy
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man. He is facing forward but turned slightly to one side, with a solemn expression. He has long, curly hair, a ruffled cravat, and a mantle draped over one shoulder. The portrait is in an oval frame with ornate decorations. Below the portrait is text identifying the man as Jacques III, Roy d'Angleterre, aged 46 years.

artworks.title: Philippe, Duke of Anjou
artworks.artist: Gerard Edelinck after François de Troy
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body, with the focus on their head and torso. The person is looking slightly to the right but appears to be gazing at the viewer. They have long, curly hair reaching their shoulders, delicate facial features, and a soft expression with slightly parted lips. The person is wearing luxurious clothing, including an embroidered jacket and a lace-trimmed cravat, indicating high status. There are no visible jewelry or objects in their hands. The portrait is within an oval frame, with a neutral background. At the bottom of the image is an inscription that reads "Philippe Duc d'Anjou" along with decorative elements.

artworks.title: Pierre de Carcavy
artworks.description: The image features an engraved portrait of a man from the chest up, slightly turned to his right. He has distinct features, including a broad nose and full cheeks, and curly shoulder-length hair with a small cap. The man is dressed in a formal 17th-century European garment, consisting of a dark coat and a wide white collar. The robe's sleeves are voluminous and ornate. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate frame with an inscription. Below the frame is a decorative coat of arms with a shield and floral patterns. The background has a detailed engraved halo-effect pattern.

artworks.title: Antoine Furetiere
artworks.artist: Gerard Edelinck after Gilbert de Seve
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with distinct facial features. He is looking directly at the viewer. The man has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and high cheekbones. His hair is long, curly, and falls naturally to his shoulders. He is dressed in a dark robe with a white collar. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by the man. The background is a dark shade within an oval frame, with linear patterns around it. There is decorative script at the bottom of the portrait.

artworks.title: Sir Robert Henley, Bart.
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man portrayed from the chest up, slightly turned to his left while facing forward. He has a high forehead, arched eyebrows, and a focused gaze. The man has long, wavy hair that falls to his shoulders. He is dressed in a draped garment with a lace collar and a bow pinned at the front. The portrait is encircled by an ornate oval frame with a coat of arms below. The background contains delicate etching.

artworks.title: Study for Man Making an Explosion
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a muscular figure manipulating a large plunger-like object inside a barrel within a classical architectural environment. Multiple figures in varied postures are gathered around in the background. The setting includes classical architectural elements like arches and columns, rendered with detailed line work. The use of lines and curves conveys a sense of movement and tension.

artworks.title: Study for Harpocrates (Silentio Deum Cole)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with wash
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 12 x 8.7 cm (4 3/4 x 3 7/16 in.)
support: 21 x 16.7 cm (8 1/4 x 6 9/16 in.)

artworks.title: Female Saint (Saint Clare of Assisi or Saint Catherine of Siena?)
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their arms extended outward. The individual is facing the viewer, wearing a hood and a flowing garment that wraps around their body. The person has a serene expression, and there is a hint of an architectural structure in the background. Another smaller figure nearby mirrors the central figure's pose. The drawing has a textured, earthy tone.

artworks.title: Magdalen
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated in a relaxed position with flowing fabric covering their legs and part of their body. The figure is turned to the left, with their left arm extended and head slightly turned to the right. They have long wavy hair, and defined facial features, with a gaze directed upward. The person is dressed in loose-fitting garments with a historical style. The scene is outdoors surrounded by foliage, with two additional figures in the background. A skull is partially visible on the ground in the lower left corner, and an ornate vessel is near the figure's feet. The background consists of lush trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Resting Cows
artworks.description: The image shows a group of cattle resting and standing in a grassy area. In the background, a rolling landscape with trees and a structure can be seen. The sky above has intricate line work forming cloud patterns. Two figures are seated under a tree to the right. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and white emphasizing texture.

artworks.title: The Happy Patriot
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a dynamic pose. He has one foot on the ground and the other lifted, twisting slightly to one side. His head is tilted back slightly with his eyes closed. He has long, wavy hair and is wearing a tunic, pants, and holding a hat in his left hand and a vessel in his right hand. The background includes cliffs on the left, a campsite with tents and a horse on the right, and swirling clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Rinaldo and Armida
artworks.description: The image depicts two central figures with most of their bodies visible. One person is seated on the ground and leans back slightly with their legs extended, their arm resting on the other's shoulder. The other person kneels next to them, partially leaning over with their arm raised above the other's head. The facial features of the person on the left include a calm expression, and they have loose, wavy hair. Both individuals are dressed in flowing garments. No specific jewelry or objects are evident except some drapery on the ground. In the background, there are dense, wooded trees, rocky formations, and faint figures that seem to be observing from a distance.

artworks.title: Frontispiece
artworks.description: The image depicts an architectural setting with elaborate structures, including a grand building with a two-story facade, columns, and decorative panels. A fountain with cascading water and sculpted horses is at the center. The style features precise line work and attention to detail, reminiscent of engravings. The color palette is mainly sepia and black. Figures in period attire are seen in the foreground, and trees frame the composition.

artworks.title: Landscape with Horsemen and Bridge
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with several figures on horseback under a canopy of trees. A structure is seen on the right with a person on its steps, interacting with the riders. A bridge spans a body of water on the left, leading to a more open landscape. A solitary figure walks towards the bridge while another stands near a tree. In the distance, a horizon is lined with trees and the sky above is vast. The etching is monochromatic, using intricate line work for textures and forms, hatching for shadows, and depth.

artworks.title: Landscape with Church and Town in Distance
artworks.description: The image depicts a panoramic landscape from a slightly elevated viewpoint. A chapel with a tiled roof and a cross is seen on the left, with figures nearby. In the distance, a river winds through the terrain with trees scattered along its banks. The horizon is high, showing buildings and hills far off. The etching technique uses fine lines and cross-hatching to define shapes and textures in a monochrome palette.

artworks.title: Landscape with Chateau
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a castle-like structure on the right side. The horizon is high in the composition with more landscape and distant trees. The style is detailed with line work and etching. A figure tends to sheep in the foreground, with a body of water reflecting nearby structures. A bridge leads to the castle with cylindrical towers and pointed rooftops. The color palette is sepia and black, with trees framing the left side.

artworks.title: Landscape with Houses
artworks.description: The image shows a small village with a mountainous backdrop. A tall tree with gnarled branches is in the foreground, with village houses slightly behind it. The houses have simple designs with clear lines and wooden textures. A pathway leads towards the horizon, where mountains rise in the distance. The color scheme is monochrome, emphasizing black and white. The detailed etching technique highlights texture, depth, dimension, and perspective in the scene.

artworks.title: Landscape with Classical Ruins
artworks.description: The image shows a classical architectural scene with detailed structures and a vast landscape. The horizon is low in the scene, with distant mountains and a winding river. Close by are ruins of a grand building with upright and fallen columns, with vegetation growing around them. A series of columns to the right extend into the distance, and two figures stand on the stone surface. The etching technique includes hatched shading and precise lines for details. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of black and grey, creating a timeless appearance.

artworks.title: Landscape with City in Distance
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a landscape with an architectural structure, trees, a path, cityscape on the horizon, and birds flying in the sky. The etching features precise linework detailing the scenery.

artworks.title: Mountain Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape with a rocky inlet between high cliffs. The horizon is under a cloudy sky with sailing ships at sea. On the horizon, there are structures on cliffs. The detailed etching shows texture on rocks, water, and clouds. The color scheme is monochromatic, emphasizing light and dark contrast via lines. A goat is on a nearby rocky outcrop with a waterfall cascading down a cliff. The scene extends towards the sea.
